about: The stable code of every refusal the graph-spec library gives outside the reader (API-8): a call handed what it cannot work on. The reader's own problems have their codes in src/reader/problem-codes.json. A code is GR and two digits, or GL and two digits for the layout, never reused and never renumbered. Each raise passes its code as a literal; packages/graph-spec/test/refusal.test.mjs holds every throw of the library to a code here.

codes.GR01: an axis of time that is neither recorded nor real (as-at.js)
codes.GR02: a number RFC 8785 cannot write: NaN or an infinity (canonical-json.js)
codes.GR03: a lens asked for by an id that is no lens (saved-lenses.js)
codes.GR04: a transition to promote that is not there (process/core.js)
codes.GR05: a promoted transition's id that is already a thing (process/core.js)
codes.GR06: a guard function at a version that is not given (process/core.js)
codes.GR07: a running rule that is none of the rules (process/core.js)
codes.GR08: a run asked for that is no run (process/core.js)
codes.GR09: states that contain each other in a loop (process/runs.js)
codes.GR10: a cluster kind that is none of the kinds (clusters.js)
codes.GR11: a way of showing cycles that is none of the ways (cycles.js)
codes.GR12: a guard that is more than comparisons, or too long or deep (guards.js)
codes.GR13: a guard naming a value its context does not hold (guards.js)
codes.GR14: a thing with a list as a value, which the flat projection cannot hold (projection.js)
codes.GR15: a thing with a property named type, which the flat projection cannot hold (projection.js)
codes.GR16: a lens rule that needs an engine to run (lenses.js)
codes.GR17: a constraint written in GQL with no named twin, which needs an engine (validate.js)
codes.GR18: a document's trust that is not own, trusted or untrusted (trust.js)
codes.GL01: the layout handed one key as text where a collection of keys goes (graph-layout.js)
codes.GL02: the layout handed no direction, and a style that sets none (graph-layout.js)
